Many of his theoretical articles from this period,"}, {"title": "Sergei Eisenstein", "paragraph_text": "have continued to have a major impact on subsequent filmmakers. Eisenstein believed that editing could be used for more than just expounding a scene or moment, through a \"linkage\" of related images. Eisenstein felt the \"collision\" of shots could be used to manipulate the emotions of the audience and create film metaphors. He believed that an idea should be derived from the juxtaposition of two independent shots, bringing an element of collage into film. This place is often used in legal documents, together with name and date of birth, to uniquely identify a person. As a general rule with respect to passports, the place of birth is determined to be country that currently has \"sovereignty\" over the actual place of birth regardless of when the birth actually occurred. The place of birth is not necessarily the place where the parents of the new baby live. If the baby is born in a hospital in another"}, {"title": "Place of birth", "paragraph_text": "ship (if the birth occurs in the territorial waters or airspace of a country). For US citizens born abroad that under the US Constitution acquire US citizenship at the time of birth, the Nationality at Birth will be USA (American), while Place of Birth would be the country in which the actual birth takes place. Place of birth The place of birth (POB) or"}, {"title": "Place of birth", "paragraph_text": "place, that place is the place of birth. In many countries, this also means that the government requires that the birth of the new baby is registered in the place of birth. Q: Who is Titus Junius Brutus's paternal grandfather?
A: "Titus Junius Brutus's father is Lucius Junius Brutus. Lucius Junius Brutus's father is not mentioned in the text. However, Lucius Junius Brutus is the son of Tarquinius Collatinus and Tana. Thus, Titus Junius Brutus's paternal grandfather is Tarquinius Collatinus. So the answer is: Tarquinius Collatinus."
A: Tarquinius Collatinus

Who is Pepin Of Herstal's paternal grandfather?
A: [{"title": "Pepin of Herstal", "paragraph_text": "a civil war after his death in which the latter emerged victorious. Pepin, sometimes called Pepin II and Pepin the Middle, was the grandson and namesake of Pepin I the Elder through the marriage of Pepin I's daughter Begga to Ansegisel. All of these are relations which do not relate to the person directly by blood. Alternatively, the spouse of your spouse's sibling may be called a co-sibling-in-law, or co-sibling. More commonly this is referred to by the gendered terms: brother-in-law, or co-brother-in-law for a male non-blood sibling, and sister-in-law or co-sister-in-law for a female non-blood sibling. Q: Which film has the director who was born first, Perdón, Viejita or Smokey And The Bandit?
A: "Perd\u00f3n, Viejita was directed by Jos\u00e9 A. Ferreyra. Jos\u00e9 A. Ferreyra was born on August 28, 1889. Smokey and the Bandit was directed by Hal Needham. Q: Which film has the director who was born later, Tarzan'S Hidden Jungle or The Brink'S Job?
A: "The film Tarzan's Hidden Jungle was directed by Harold D. Schuster. The Brink's Job was directed by William Friedkin. William Friedkin was born on August 27, 1935. Harold D. Schuster was born on January 1, 1892. Thus, the person to be born later from the two is The Brink's Job. So the answer is: The Brink's Job."
A: The Brink's Job

Q: Which film has the director who is older than the other, My Own Private Idaho or Bread, Love And Dreams?
A: "My Own Private Idaho was directed by Gus Van Sant. Gus Van Sant was born on July 24, 1952. Bread, Love and Dreams was directed by Luigi Comencini. Luigi Comencini was born on January 30, 1918. Thus, Luigi Comencini is older than Gus Van Sant. So the answer is: Bread, Love and Dreams."
A: Bread, Love and Dreams

Q: Which film whose director was born first, The Olsen Gang'S Big Score or To Be Or Not To Be (1983 Film)?
A: "The Olsen Gang's Big Score was directed by Erik Balling. Erik Balling was born in 1924. To Be or Not to Be (1983 film) was directed by Alan Johnson. Alan Johnson was born in 1937. Thus, Erik Balling was born first. So the answer is: The Olsen Gang's Big Score."

Q: Who is Maud Of Gloucester, Countess Of Chester's father-in-law?
A: "Maud of Gloucester, Countess of Chester's husband is Ranulf de Gernon, 4th Earl of Chester. Ranulf de Gernon's father is Hugh d'Avranches, 1st Earl of Chester. Thus, Maud of Gloucester, Countess of Chester's father-in-law is Hugh d'Avranches, 1st Earl of Chester. So the answer is: Hugh d'Avranches, 1st Earl of Chester."

All of these are relations which do not relate to the person directly by blood. Alternatively, the spouse of your spouse's sibling may be called a co-sibling-in-law, or co-sibling. Q: Which film has the director born earlier, Everyone Else or The Girl From The Chartreuse?
A: "Everyone Else was directed by Maren Ade. The Girl from the Chartreuse was directed by Jean-Pierre Denis. Maren Ade was born in the year 1976. Jean-Pierre Denis was born in the year 1959. Thus, of the two, the director to be born earlier is Jean-Pierre Denis. So the answer is: The Girl from the Chartreuse."
A: The Girl from the Chartreuse

Q: Who is the paternal grandfather of Charles Bruce, 5Th Earl Of Elgin?
A: "Charles Bruce, 5th Earl of Elgin is the son of William Bruce, 8th Earl of Kincardine. William Bruce, 8th Earl of Kincardine is the son of Thomas Bruce, 7th Earl of Kincardine. Thus, the paternal grandfather of Charles Bruce, 5th Earl of Elgin is Thomas Bruce, 7th Earl of Elgin. So the answer is: Thomas Bruce, 7th Earl of Elgin."
A: Thomas Bruce, 7th Earl of Elgin

Devil's wheels have been used at Oktoberfest celebrations since at least 1910. A Devil's wheel is a rotating circular platform upon which riders sit or lie. It begins by spinning slowly and increases its speed to make riders slide off the platform. Spectators stand around the platform, the announcers often offer some satirical commentary. Riders who slide off the platform usually hit a cushioned wall. Injuries are possible if riders collide with spectators or other objects. An operator controls"}, {"title": "Devil's wheel", "paragraph_text": "the speed of the platform, sometimes slowing it down to give participants the opportunity to re-position themselves toward the center. This complicates movement towards or away from the center of the wheel. If one is moving radially outward, in addition to the expected centrifugal force (directed outward), the Coriolis force applies directed tangentially (i.e. laterally). Q: When was Patrick Berg's father born?
A: "Patrick Berg is the son of \u00d8rjan Berg. \u00d8rjan Berg was born on 20 August 1968. His father is Harald Berg. Harald Berg was born on 9 November 1941. Thus, Harald Berg was born before \u00d8rjan Berg. So the answer is: 9 November 1941."
A: 9 November 1941

Prometheus (art song) \"Prometheus\" (D. 674) is an intensely dramatic art song composed by Franz Schubert in October 1819 to a poem of the same name by Johann Wolfgang von Goethe. The \"\" was written for bass voice in the key of B major, but the key moves repeatedly through various major to minor tonalities, ending in C major. In Goethe's dramatic declamation by Prometheus, which would be set again, with very different effect, by Hugo Wolf, \"with his alternations of ariosos and recitatives, Schubert created a miniature oratorio\", observes Edward F. Leonard Calvert's father is George Calvert. Thus, Cecil Calvert, 2nd Baron Baltimore's paternal grandfather is George Calvert. So the answer is: George Calvert."
A: George Calvert

Q: Who is Blanche Of Navarre, Queen Of France's maternal grandfather?
A: "Blanche Of Navarre, Queen Of France is the daughter of Charles III of Navarre and Eleanor of Castile. Charles III of Navarre is the son of John II of Aragon and Blanche I of Navarre. Thus, Blanche I of Navarre is the maternal grandmother of Blanche Of Navarre, Queen Of France. Blanche I of Navarre is the daughter of John I of Navarre and Blanche of Artois."
A: Blanche Of Navarre, Queen Of France is the daughter of Charles III of Navarre and Eleanor of Castile. Charles III of Navarre is the son of John II of Aragon and Blanche I of Navarre. Thus, Blanche I of Navarre is the maternal grandmother of Blanche Of Navarre, Queen Of France. Blanche I of Navarre is the daughter of John I of Navarre and Blanche of Artois

It was the first film directed by Manoel de Oliveira and is a portrait of his hometown of Porto and the labor and industry that takes place along the city's main river, the Douro River. It was first shown at the International Congress of Film Critics in Lisbon on September 19, 1931, where the majority of the Portuguese audience booed. However, other foreign critics and artists who were in attendance praised the film, such as Luigi Pirandello and \u00c9mile Vuillermoz. A: [{"title": "J'accuse (1919 film)", "paragraph_text": "J'accuse (1919 film) J'accuse is a 1919 French silent film directed by Abel Gance. It juxtaposes a romantic drama with the background of the horrors of World War I, and it is sometimes described as a pacifist or anti-war film. Work on the film began in 1918, and some scenes were filmed on real battlefields. The film's powerful depiction of wartime suffering, and particularly its climactic sequence of the \"return of the dead\", made it an international success, and confirmed Gance as one of the most important directors in Europe. In a Proven\u00e7al village in the south of France, the"}, {"title": "J'accuse (1919 film)", "paragraph_text": "A new restoration of the film was produced by Lobster Films Studios, Paris, working in collaboration with Nederlands Filmmuseum and Flicker Alley. Some outline a general plotline and let the actors improvise dialogue, while others control every aspect, and demand that the actors and crew follow instructions precisely. Some directors also write their own screenplays or collaborate on screenplays with long-standing writing partners. In post-production, the director works with the editor to edit the material into the director's cut. Well-established directors have the \"final cut privilege\", meaning that they have the final say on which edit of the film is released. For other directors, the studio can order further edits without the director's permission.
